title: gateway.rs secure-response serializer: content_format 0 encodes as present empty option 0xc0 (decodes text/plain), diverging from C's omitted option
description: Found during bead 3mz9 review (pass 1+3, 2026-09-09). rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:1574-1590 maps CoapResponse.content_format 0 to a PRESENT zero-length Content-Format option (0xc0). Per RFC 7252 uint shortest-encoding, an empty value decodes as 0 = text/plain;charset=utf-8, so cf=0 responses (bad_request, all 4.xx without format, and the 4.09 slot-conflict COSE echo resources.rs:3232) are wire-labeled text/plain. C coap_oscore_respond_resource treats cf 0 as option OMITTED (coap_oscore.h:138 '0 for none'), so the C contract 'no Content-Format on the 4.09 echo' has no Rust byte-parity. Options: (A) treat cf 0 as omit-the-option in gateway.rs (byte-parity with C; touches every 4.xx error response), (B) document divergence and never use cf 0 for meaningful payloads. Comment in 12gq has the current-state evidence (the old 'options=&[] discard' is already fixed). Affects OSCORE Class-E option 12 encoding in the protected plaintext.
close_reason: Fixed (Option A: omit-the-option, byte-parity with C). The secure-response serializer in rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs previously mapped content_format==0 to a present-but-empty Content-Format option (0xc0), which decodes as uint value 0 = text/plain;charset=utf-8 — diverging from C's '0 for none' (coap_oscore.h:135; lichen_coap_respond only appends the option when payload non-empty; the protected path coap_oscore.c:286-292 never emits any inner Content-Format). Extracted the encoder into a testable free fn encode_content_format_option: cf==0 -> OMIT the option (len 0, byte-parity with C); cf 1..=255 -> 0xc1+1 byte; cf 256..=65535 -> 0xc2+2 big-endian bytes. Updated the serializer call site and comment. Added unit test content_format_zero_omits_the_option (0/60/112/255/256/65535 boundaries). Also fixed two now-misleading comments in resources.rs (1044 'text/plain' label, 1007 struct doc) since cf=0 now means 'no option on the wire', not a text/plain label. Converges with node-side serializer (secure_dispatch.rs:91-95 already emits options:&[]). Tests: 253/253 lib pass; the only e2e failure is the PRE-EXISTING CoapEncode slot-claim bug (verified via stash on clean tree; tracked on l1qw.16). 3x codereview delegated to reviewer model kimi-k3: correctness PASS, security PASS (OSCORE Class-E option sits in AEAD plaintext not AAD, so omitting it weakens no integrity coverage; downgrade/replay resistance unchanged), edge-cases PASS (buf size sufficient, 255/256 boundary correct, empty-slice downstream safe). Committed as 49e460a240.
